definitions: The quality or state of being different or diverse; the absence of uniformity or monotony.
A number or collection of different things, especially of a particular type.
A thing which differs in some way from others of the same general class or type; a sort or kind.
A cultivated plant that has been selected and given a unique name because of its distinctive characteristics.
A form of entertainment consisting of a series of different acts, such as singing, dancing, and comedy.
examples: The shop sells a wide variety of goods.
He enjoys the variety that his job offers.
This is a new variety of rose.
The show featured a variety of acts.
